task.question: What was the outcome of the 2026 São Toméan presidential election in July?
task.evidence: July 19 – The 2026 São Toméan presidential election was held, with incumbent nonpartisan President Carlos Vila Nova re-elected for a second five-year term.

prediction:
The outcome of the 2026 São Toméan presidential election held on July 19, 2026, was that incumbent president Carlos Vila Nova won re-election as an independent candidate, receiving 55.88% of the vote. His main opponent, Nito Abreu, received 41.46%. The voter turnout was a record low of 41%.

FINAL: Carlos Vila Nova re-elected with 55.88% of the vote.
